'''Ruin''' is a [[debuff]] primarily found in [[Ultimatum]] encounters, as well as a modifier for [[Valdo's Map]]s. Accumulating 7 stacks of Ruin will cause the party to fail the Ultimatum encounter, and kick players out to the main area of the map if they were currently in the [[Trialmaster]]'s arena. In Valdo's Maps, failing will prevent the reward chest from spawning.

==Mechanics==
Enemy attacks that apply Ruin are subject to a shared cooldown between applications, preventing additional stacks from being applied until a short delay has passed, regardless of the number of sources.

[[Evasion]], [[spell dodge]], hit avoidance, and [[block]] (with or without damage taken from block e.g. {{psl|id=glancing_blows_keystone2693}}) prevent Ruin from being applied.<ref>https://youtu.be/zYl71wC72TA?si=OaHHJaj0bFLnInCh</ref><ref>https://youtu.be/0QibCq3AqlQ?si=d4CNyZT9VALD2Avx</ref> Though the melee attacks of shades spawned by Stalking Ruin cannot be Evaded.

Ruin is tracked independently per player in a [[party]]. In [[map]]s, players can fail the Ultimatum encounter and lose all of their accumulated rewards, but this will not end the encounter for other players. In {{il|Inscribed Ultimatum}}s, only the instance owner can accumulate Ruin; other players will not gain Ruin stacks when hit.

A variant of Ruin can also be gained from using {{il|Dark Bargain of Trarthus}}. Though it grants a separate debuff, the failure on 7 Ruin mechanic uses the sum of both types of debuffs.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3792399#p26211786</ref> However, the Ultimatum will fail only if the Ruin modifier is present in the encounter.

The {{psl|Ruinous Wager}} [[Atlas keystone passive]] adds the effect of Ruin to all Ultimatum encounters. This does not block the "Ruin" modifier from spawning and does not stack with it. Higher tiers of the Ruin modifier will override it.

{{il|Valdo's Puzzle Box}} maps with the {{c|mod|Players are assaulted by Ruinous Ghosts}} adds Stalking Ruin ghosts that inflict Ruin on hit. At 7 Ruin, the map becomes impossible to complete and won't drop a Singular Reliquary.
